comments.author: @RichardFennimore
comments.text:
The estimated population of PEI as of April 2026 is 181,715. That makes PEI the most densely populated province. 

Prince Edward Island: 37/km²
Nova Scotia: 18/km²
Ontario: 16/km²
New Brunswick: 11/km²
Quebec: 7/km²
British Columbia: 6/km²
Alberta: 5/km²
Saskatchewan: 2/km²
Manitoba: 2/km²
Newfoundland and Labrador: 1.5/km²

These figures are for full time residents. When you add almost 2 million visitors each year (most recent full-year data from Tourism PEI shows a record-breaking 1.87 million non-resident tourists visited in 2025 - mostly summer), it's a very busy island. 

Coastal waters hit their peak warmth by late August, typically reaching comfortable swimming temperatures of 19°C to 21°C (66°F to 70°F). The average summer air temperature stays around 23°C (73°F), however heatwaves can occasionally push temperatures to over 32°C (90°F).
